title: Tight PAC-Bayes Generalisation Guarantees for Large Language Model Judges
abstract: arXiv:2611.20818v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used to monitor the outputs of LLM-based AI agents, yet formal guarantees on the reliability of these judges remain largely absent, limiting confidence in their use for safety-critical oversight. We consider certifying such a judge and define its risk over safety classifications of prompt--response pairs drawn from a deployed generator. We apply a PAC-Bayes framework to this setting, refining existing compression-based methodology with the use of tighter bounds and more efficient coding. We show that standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning can yield non-vacuous and even tight certificates for safety judges, for both classification and Brier risk, without holding out data for validation. We introduce LoRA-GT, which shares a single quantisation scale across layers and achieves the tightest certificates with minimal degradation in predictive performance. translated_title: 大语言模型评判器的紧致PAC-Bayes泛化保证
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）评判器日益被用于监控基于大语言模型的AI智能体的输出，然而关于这些评判器可靠性的形式化保证在很大程度上仍然缺失，这限制了人们将其用于安全关键监督时的信心。我们考虑对这类评判器进行认证，并在从已部署生成器中抽取的提示-响应对的安全分类上定义其风险。我们将PAC-Bayes框架应用于这一场景，通过使用更紧致的界和更高效的编码来改进现有的基于压缩的方法论。我们证明，标准的参数高效微调可以为安全评判器产生非平凡甚至紧致的证书，同时涵盖分类风险和Brier风险，且无需保留数据进行验证。我们提出了LoRA-GT方法，它在各层之间共享单一的量化尺度，在预测性能仅有极小退化的情况下实现了最紧致的证书。在五个护栏模型和……
tldr: 本文提出基于PAC-Bayes框架并结合LoRA-GT参数高效微调方法，首次为大语言模型安全评判器提供了非平凡甚至紧致的泛化保证证书，且无需保留验证数据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a PAC-Bayes framework combined with LoRA-GT parameter-efficient fine-tuning to provide non-vacuous and tight generalisation certificates for LLM safety judges without holding out validation data.
